title: InferenceResult
description: Schema for the result of a single inference run, including generated image metadata and routing decisions.

sample_id.description: Reference to the original sample ID.

predicted_routing_label.description: The expert label predicted by the model or tree.

ground_truth_routing_label.description: The expert label from the teacher model (if available).

generated_image_path.description: Relative path to the generated image file.

velocity_vector.description: The velocity vector used for generation.

inference_time_ms.description: Time taken for inference in milliseconds.

error_message.description: Error details if status is not success.
